rationale: The original entry rationale required price to hold above VWAP ($22.70) as a key condition, but the last three candles show a sustained breakdown below VWAP with accelerating selling pressure (candle lows of $22.62, $22.43, $22.35) and high volume confirming distribution rather than absorption. The maximum adverse excursion of -1.32% already dwarfs the maximum favorable excursion of 0.13%, indicating the trade has never worked in our favor, and current price at $22.60 is now below VWAP and trending toward the $22.20 invalidation. Closing now preserves capital and avoids a likely stop-out at a worse price.
